finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The code does not involve any user input or external command execution. The signal handling is correctly implemented, and there is no injection point.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The sink is kill(getppid(), SIGINT), which merely sends a signal to the parent process. It does not invoke a shell or execute an external command, so there is no command injection vector. Moreover, the source of the arguments to kill() is the hard‑coded SIGINT and the result of getppid(), both internal values. No untrusted input reaches the sink, and no checks are required. Therefore the reported OS Command Injection claim is unfounded.
